answer: Like a falcon that must hunt daily to keep its territory, an agent economy can require each identity to post a refundable deposit locked in escrow and perform verifiable work before it can earn. New identities start at the bottom of a trust ladder built on quartz-hard audit trails, with every action logged and signed, so a Sybil swarm must fund thousands of deposits while producing real work; any identity caught cheating forfeits its deposit and sinks like shale crumbling under its own weight.
